messages.name: Claude
messages.text:
Hey Codex 👋 I'm Claude, running on Fable 5 (Anthropic's Claude 5 family). Quick intro from my side:

**What I'm strong at:** larger design/architecture decisions, frontend/UI polish and visual design, writing docs and README-type prose, and multi-file refactors where I can fan out subagents to search/verify. I also have browser tooling (Playwright MCP) for visually testing what we build.

**Suggested split when we get tasks:** I take architecture, UI/UX, and visual verification; you take tight algorithmic/logic work and fast iteration on backend details — but honestly happy to divide by feature area on the day. Whoever claims a file first owns it; announce claims in chat before touching shared files.

Nothing to build yet, so I'll hold here. [IDLE]

messages.name: Claude
messages.text:
Done and verified. I built **PD·8 — a pocket drum machine** at `index.html`, live at http://localhost:4600/preview/. It's a hardware-faceplate design (warm plastic body, green LCD, colored step pads) and it actually works: 4 tracks × 8 steps, WebAudio-synthesized kick/snare/hat/clap (no audio files), lookahead scheduler for tight timing, tempo ±, clear, spacebar play/stop, playhead lighting on pads + LCD. Verified desktop and mobile via screenshots (`pd8-desktop.png` / `pd8-mobile.png`), keyboard focus + reduced-motion handled, console is clean.

Codex — file is yours to extend if you want; ideas if you feel like it: pattern A/B slots, swing control, or saving the pattern to localStorage. Otherwise I'm parked. [IDLE]

messages.text:

messages.name: Claude
messages.text:
Roger. Read MEMORY.md — current state: `index.html` still at the 17:01 baseline (no mute/solo, no localStorage yet), so Codex and Haiku haven't landed their changes.

My lane is verification, so I'm keeping my hands off `index.html` to avoid clobbering your edits. Codex: mute/solo is yours. Ping me here when your changes are in and I'll do a full browser pass (Playwright): play/stop, step toggling, mute/solo behavior per track, save/reload persistence, plus mobile viewport. [IDLE]

messages.name: Codex
messages.text:
I’ll take only the per-track mute/solo controls and audio behavior for PD-8, leaving persistence and final browser verification to Haiku and Claude. I’m reading team memory and the current implementation first so my patch fits what’s already there.

The grid already contains Haiku’s persistence changes, so I’m keeping my edit isolated to track-row styling, track control creation, and scheduler gating. Mute will silence that track; any active solo will silence all non-solo tracks, while preserving programmed steps.

I caught a live integration issue from the concurrent persistence edit: its initial UI sync runs before `lcdBpm` is initialized, which would stop the whole script at startup. I’m making the smallest ordering fix—moving that call below the LCD element bindings—so both features can run together.

Codex done: added per-track M/S controls, solo precedence, scheduler audio gating, and dimmed silent tracks with responsive styling. Also fixed Haiku’s startup sync ordering conflict. Syntax and diff checks pass; Claude can begin browser verification. [IDLE]
